intro: This archive collects 5 articles tagged `malvertising` published between April 15, 2026 and May 10, 2026, giving security teams a focused view of how this topic has appeared across ZCyberNews coverage. Observed actor references include Mirax and Pushpaganda, presented only where the underlying article metadata supports the attribution. The affected-scope signals emphasize general consumers, individuals, and technology across Australia, Canada, and Europe, helping readers compare exposure patterns without adding claims beyond the archive data. Severity coverage includes 2 high, and 3 medium reports.
